purpose: SV-authored display tags for the 18-skill SVAERA mastery graft.
integration_status: ALREADY WIRED via the data path - no phase-2 action required.

data_path.mechanism: build_svc_database.py main() writes these key=value pairs into work/SoulvizierClassic/Database/uber_soul_tags.txt (the graft_tags dict). tools/build_text_arc.py reads uber_soul_tags.txt as its 3rd argument and (a) emits every key into modstrings.txt inside Text.arc AND (b) lists every key in the mod_authored_tags.txt manifest. tools/validate_tags.py then treats them as mod-owned AND finds them defined -> PASS.
data_path.source_of_strings: Ported verbatim from the real SVAERA Text.arc (workshop item 2076433374); fancy quotes normalized to ASCII.

base_atlantis_tags_no_action.note: These display tags resolve at runtime from the engine's own base-game Atlantis Text (the mod overlays on base). They are NOT authored by the mod and are intentionally absent from uber_soul_tags.txt.

tags.tagSlam_DESC: Hit all enemies in a straight line with staggering force. {^n}{^y}The length of the line extends with levels. {^n}{^y}Melee weapon or Staff required.
tags.tagSlam_FissureDESC: Your slam can be cast more frequently, and creates a larger and more powerful fissure in the ground, disrupting the aim and spellcasting of your enemies. ^y^n(The width of the line extends with levels. Reduced cooldown starts at level 2)
tags.tagBurningBoltsDESC: Adds burn damage to staff attacks, and a chance to pass through enemies.
tags.tagSVAERSkillStormDescription001: Casts an expanding ring of frost that slows and freezes your enemies.

sv_tags_already_shipped_not_readded.note: These 4 display tags ALREADY exist in the mod's SV 0.98i text (Resources/Text_EN.arc -> xuniqueequipment.txt), so the grafted Earth Rupture/Flare skills resolve to the existing definitions. They are intentionally NOT emitted by the graft: build_text_arc keeps the FIRST definition, so re-adding them is a no-op for the same-value ones and a HARD duplicate-tag-gate failure for tagRuptureDESC (0.98i value says 'Staff Only'; SVAERA's says 'Staff or Bow'). The build's duplicate-tag gate CAUGHT this on the first Text build; dropping these 4 from the graft is the fix.

tags.tagRuptureDESC: 0.98i: 'Connects the player's tumultuous earth energies to their staff... ^y(Staff Only)' - a minor cosmetic mismatch (SVAERA's Rupture is Staff-or-Bow); functionally fine, not overridable via the data path.

expected_tags_gate_delta.measured: validate_tags PASS on the rebuilt arz+Text: 'all 148 referenced mod tags present' + 'all 205 authoritative tags present'. The 8 new tags are in the mod_authored_tags.txt manifest (220 mod-owned) and defined in Text.arc.
expected_tags_gate_delta.acceptable_lane_level_delta: none - the data path makes the tags gate PASS clean; there is no residual tags-gate failure from this lane.
